concept.title: Design
concept.shortdesc: Design items are read in Requirements; there is no separate Design page, and its old address opens Requirements with the Type: Design item filter on. Switch to Tree to see the items nested as they are in the document: an item under another is drawn under it.

conbody.p: Select an item to read it in the detail panel: its text straight under its title, its attributes, the requirements it satisfies (and anything else it links to, such as the hazards it mitigates), and Verified through: the test cases that verify those requirements, each with its last result. Test cases verify requirements rather than design items, so this is the evidence that reaches the item through them.
To see what a change would touch, run Impact from a requirement the item satisfies: it flows down to the item and what it links to.
